author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet: Just before the Artemis II crew began its historic slingshot around the moon this past April, NASA announced plans to build Space Reactor-1 Freedom. SR-1, the first-ever nuclear-reactor-­powered interplanetary spacecraft, is meant to fly an uncrewed mission to Mars by the end of 2028, arriving in 2029. title: Exercise in a pill
title_en: Exercise in a pill
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:

By deciphering how movement benefits the body, researchers hope to develop medicines that can offer some of the same perks—without the workout. The idea isn’t to replace exercise but to bring its upsides to people who struggle with frailty, disability, or chronic illness.

summary_en: Researchers are deciphering the molecular cascade triggered by physical activity to develop pills that mimic the health perks of exercise for frail and chronically ill individuals. title: Cleaning up PFAS
title_en: Cleaning up PFAS
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
Scrubbing Earth of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances—a.k.a. PFAS or forever chemicals—could eliminate a list of woes for people and planet. Used for decades in everything from nonstick pans to firefighting foams, PFAS have been linked to increased risks of fertility challenges, developmental delays, cancer, and reduced immune response. They are known for a strong bond between carbon and fluorine, which the environment struggles to break down.

summary_en: Europe's push to build out AI data centers has run headfirst into its binding climate goal of cutting greenhouse gas emissions by 55% this decade. title: It’s a bird, it’s a plane … it’s a robo-puffin?

title: A reason to eat carbs
title_en: A reason to eat carbs
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
A high-fat, low-carbohydrate diet can help some people lose weight, and some research has shown that it may protect against colon cancer. But a new study suggests that such a ketogenic diet may also increase the risk of cancer in the small intestine.

This type of diet forces the body to burn fatty acids instead of carbohydrates for fuel, producing by-products called ketone bodies. One of these, BHB, was thought to be responsible for the protective effect observed against colon cancer.

Omer Yil
summary_en: A new study led by the MIT Stem Cell Initiative found that while high-fat, low-carb ketogenic diets generate ketone bodies that may shield against colon cancer, they paradoxically increase tumor development in the small intestine in mouse models. The findings cast serious doubt on treating keto as a risk-free metabolic panacea.

summary_en: Researchers from Purdue University and MIT have engineered an AI-powered rehabilitation robot to address the severe shortage of physical therapists for five million stroke survivors annually. title: The Internet goes on high alert after discovery of 8 compromised TLS certs

author: Ars Technica
content_snippet:
Security personnel around the world are on high alert Tuesday following the discovery of eight TLS certificates with private keys so weak they could allow anyone to mint trusted browser and app credentials for any site on the Internet.

title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations

author: The Verge AI

summary_en: Spotify announced it has purged more than 50 million AI-generated slop and spam tracks from user recommendation feeds over the past year. In response to mounting listener backlash against automated filler music, the streaming platform revised its algorithm to elevate human artists while introducing dedicated badges for synthetic tracks.

【起因与机理】AI批量生产的垃圾音频泛滥稀释了版权分成池，并引发订阅用户的强烈反感

title: TikTok staff depositions: TikTok executives ignored internal warnings about child sexual exploitation on Live, where staff said minors appeared in livestreams (Katie McQue/NPR)
title_en: TikTok staff depositions: TikTok executives ignored internal warnings about child sexual exploitation on Live, where staff said minors appeared in livestreams (Katie McQue/NPR)
author: NPR
content_snippet:
TikTok employees repeatedly raised concerns internally about the risks the short-form video app posed to children, including sexual exploitation and exposure to suicide content. Previously unreported court records show that the employees were frustrated with how the company's leadership responded to their concerns.

Depositions of staffers filed in federal court in March 2026 offer new insights into how TikTok has approached child safety since the platform exploded in popularity among young user
summary_en: Newly unsealed depositions in US federal court reveal that TikTok executives repeatedly dismissed internal warnings from staff regarding child sexual exploitation on TikTok Live. Employees alleged that minors appeared in paid sexually suggestive streams from which the company profited, while leadership deliberately avoided conducting age audits to evade regulatory scrutiny by the FTC.

summary_zh: 美国联邦法院解密员工证词，指控TikTok高层长期压制内部关于直播间存在未成年人性剥削及借此牟利的警告
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】TikTok高管层与多名提起指控的平台员工在美国联邦法院涉社交媒体青少年危害诉讼质证案：员工证词曝光高管无视直播间未成年人性剥削警告，并通过付费分成获利且刻意回避年龄普查
【起因与机理】为追求平台日活增长与直播流水变现，同时逃避监管机构的审查制裁
【调查与监管诉求】法庭公开文件显示TikTok员工多次预警直播间未成年人性剥削隐患遭高层压制。
【涉及范围与推进】高层被指为规避联邦贸易委员会调查故意叫停用户真实年龄统计。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] TikTok executive leadership and staff witnesses (US federal court filings): Employees testified leadership ignored alerts on child sexual exploitation in Live streams and avoided age audits
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Prioritizing traffic and revenue while shielding the platform from FTC scrutiny
[Key Metrics] In May, TikTok agreed to pay $8 million to settle a youth mental health and addiction lawsuit brought by a school district in rural Kentucky.
[Key Position & Outlook] Internal age-verification surveys were avoided to dodge regulatory submission requirements.

Employees alleged that minors appeared in paid sexually suggestive streams from which the company profited, while leadership deliberately avoided conducting age audits to evade regulatory scrutiny by the FTC.

summary_en: Arda, a startup founded by OpenAI's former research chief Bob McGrew to automate advanced manufacturing, has raised $230 million at a $1.5 billion valuation led by Altimeter, Accel, and Khosla Ventures. The company builds AI software agents that accelerate factory assembly retooling from months to days, already deploying its models with defense tech firm Anduril.

title: Cloudflare's Clairic pulls data from documents faster and cheaper than LLMs

author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Chinese technology giants Alibaba, Tencent, and Huawei are committing tens of billions of yuan to construct massive AI-focused data centers in Shaoguan, Guangdong province. The hinterland region was designated as a core hub in the national computing framework due to its low-cost hydropower resources and cooler climate. However, the surging electricity demands, land allocations, and environmental impacts associated with these high-density facilities have triggered local friction regarding ecological burdens and economic equity.

title: Google Cloud Outage Takes Down Revolut and Other Banks in UK
title_en: Google Cloud Outage Takes Down Revolut and Other Banks in UK
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: An outage at Google Cloud knocked out banking services in the UK including Revolut Ltd. early on Tuesday.
summary_en: Google Cloud's London infrastructure region suffered a widespread service disruption beginning late Monday, triggering outages across multiple enterprise clients in the UK. The incident notably incapacitated core banking and transaction processing systems for fintech unicorn Revolut, leaving millions of mobile banking customers unable to access accounts or complete transfers. The severe breakdown underscores the architectural vulnerability of modern fintech platforms relying on single-provider cloud infrastructures without resilient multi-region failovers.

title: Anthropic's leaked federal AI bill draws widespread criticism from AI safety advocates for being significantly weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act (Shakeel Hashim/Transformer)
title_en: Anthropic's leaked federal AI bill draws widespread criticism from AI safety advocates for being significantly weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act (Shakeel Hashim/Transformer)
author: Transformer
content_snippet: A leaked discussion draft of a federal AI bill which Anthropic has been circulating to lawmakers, published by Politico on Friday, makes that safety-first pitch ring hollow. The bill, which has been widely criticized by AI safety advocates, is much weaker than the Obernolte/Trahan FRONTIER Act, and arguably makes it legally harder to prevent a dangerous AI model from being released than it is today. It reads like Anthropic’s business interests winning out over its purported safety concerns. And
summary_en: A leaked draft of a federal AI legislative proposal crafted and privately circulated by Anthropic to U.S. lawmakers has ignited fierce backlash from safety advocates. The proposed legislation proves far weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act by omitting licensing benchmarks for third-party auditing bodies, tolerating self-certification, and complicating state authorities' power to halt hazardous releases. The move reflects Anthropic's quiet commercial pivot to preempt aggressive federal safety curbs with corporate-friendly guardrails under the banner of responsible innovation.
title_zh: Anthropic泄露的联邦人工智能法案引起了人工智能安全倡导者的广泛批评，因为它明显弱于两党边境法案
summary_zh: Anthropic向美国国会游说的AI监管法案草案外泄，因允许机构自我认证且标准过松，被批背离安全立身初心
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】大模型独角兽Anthropic、美国国会议员及AI安全倡导学者在美国国会山立法游说场域及国际科技政策圈：拟订极度宽松的联邦AI监管法案草案，允许评测机构自认证，意图弱化事前安全强监管
【起因与机理】在商业化追赶关键期利用立法先机设立保护伞，防止真正严苛的硬性安全红线遏制其商业模型发布
【调查与监管诉求】Anthropic向国会非公开分发的一份联邦AI监管法规草案遭到泄露。
【各方立场与态度】暴露出以安全为核心护城河的明星独角兽在资本与商业化冲刺下的政策妥协。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Anthropic leadership, U.S. congressional lawmakers, and AI safety organizations: Secretly circulated a watered-down AI bill allowing self-certified audits and weakening release bans

[Key Fact Detail] Leaked discussion draft reveals Anthropic's private lobbying for a diluted federal AI bill.
[Key Position & Outlook] Sparks widespread criticism that the safety-first startup prioritized corporate growth over public oversight.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 以“安全第一”为品牌基石的AI领军企业Anthropic，其秘密游说国会议员的联邦人工智能法案草案遭媒体泄露曝光。该草案内容显著弱于跨党派支持的《前沿法案》（FRONTIER Act），不仅未设定第三方安全评估机构的法定准入与牌照标准、允许评估机构自证合规，甚至在法律层面变相削弱了政府阻止高危危险模型发布的干预权。此举动因在于Anthropic试图借国会政策窗口期，以自我设定的温和规范抢先替代潜在的严厉硬性监管，为自身未来商业化模型扫清上市障碍。

The proposed legislation proves far weaker than the bipartisan FRONTIER Act by omitting licensing benchmarks for third-party auditing bodies, tolerating self-certification, and complicating state authorities' power to halt hazardous releases.
